definition: JIP3 (JNK-interacting protein 3) is a cargo adapter protein encoded by the MAPK8IP3 gene that interacts with the kinesin-1 complex and regulates axonal transport and signaling pathways in neurons; pathogenic variants in MAPK8IP3 lead to a neurodevelopmental disorder with variable brain abnormalities and neurological impairments.

source.title: A toxic gain-of-function variant in MAPK8IP3 provides insights into JIP3 cellular roles
source.quote: Mitogen-activated protein kinase 8 interacting protein 3 (MAPK8IP3) gene encoding a protein called JIP3 is an adaption protein of the kinesin-1 complex known to play a role in axonal transport of cargo.
